description:
Aisha, (EYE-sha), a name that means "alive and well," is just that - a brand that celebrates the sheer beauty of living. "Quintessential dressing, outfitting beautiful living," the tagline conveys this concept. The brand references Feng Shui in the design of women's rtw (ready-to-wear). 

 

The AISHA RTW style aesthetic can be described as timeless cosmopolitan chic designs, with some avant-garde touches and pieces throughout the collections. AISHA RTW creations are top-tier garments inside out with unique European-centric designs done for the most discerning eye and the highest aesthetic taste level. The quality, materials, and couture-like construction resonate with top-tier premium luxury rtw brands that typically sell for 3x more and never make it to a sale. AISHA RTW creations have longevity of wear. There are clients who rave they have had pieces for years plus that they wear, and those pieces are still in impeccable condition and in timeless styles, still relevant for today's fashion scene. We have a 1-year guarantee on all products, but truly AISHA RTW pieces can be worn for a lifetime and pass them down due to the super high-quality materials, textiles, and garment construction. 

 

Our ladies rave about our practical one-piece, versatile, and effortlessly chic looks. AISHA RTW's original designs, comfort silhouettes, and fine-to-the-touch fabrics are intrinsic features. The style practicality of always including pockets and never restricting wearers' movements.  

 

We offer Women's Luxury RTW

(Ready-to-wear) dresses, outerwear, and scarves. 

 

● High-quality timeless collections

● Made in NYC with some production in Italy and France

● AYR / AS (All year round / All seasons), SS, AW - 3 Collections

● One-piece outfit (The Dress)

● Price range of Coats $1,200 -$3,000, Dresses $750 - $1650, Scarves $450 -$1500

● A red line of courage (complementary lining trim) is included on all brand clothing pieces.

● Custom and exclusive limited collections available with faster turnaround 

● Fine tailoring with fine Italian fabric and skins (Fine tweeds, bouclés, wools, cashmere, silks, linens, cotton plus. Sturdy, durable, long fibers) Aisha, the chief designer, developed an affinity for Italian fabric while attending design schools in Italy, so textiles are primarily from Italy. Occasionally from France, Great Britain, and Switzerland.

 

We also offer personalized signature collections and custom with reference to Feng Shui are offered. Measurements for custom taken remotely for clients worldwide.
